summary: First-finish smoke test of StreamTrack backend + frontend. All auth endpoints, subscription CRUD, platform templates (15 items incl. Netflix/Disney+/Hulu/Max/Prime Video/Spotify), and dashboard summary work correctly. Frontend flows (login, dashboard stats, subscription add/delete via dialog, renewals timeline, logout with token cleared) all passed end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/auth/me returns 401 without token, 200 with Bearer token
POST /api/auth/register creates user and returns {token, user}
GET /api/platform-templates returns 15 pre-seeded templates (all required platforms present)
POST /api/subscriptions returns 201 with id when profile_users passed as [{name}] objects
GET /api/dashboard/summary returns total_monthly, total_yearly, total_subscriptions, total_seats, total_profiles, upcoming_renewals (sorted by days_until), spend_breakdown, region_counts
Frontend /login renders with StreamTrack branding, right-side status pattern, default admin creds shown
Login redirects to / and dashboard renders stat-monthly/yearly/subs/seats, renewals list, regions
Subscriptions page: add-subscription-btn opens dialog; add profile chip; save persists and shows sub-card-<PLATFORM>
Delete flow shows confirm modal and removes the card
Logout returns to /login and clears streamtrack_token in localStorage

failed.issue: Spec says 'profile_users list' should accept profile names (strings), but backend requires list of ProfileUser objects [{name, color?}]. Sending strings returns 422. Frontend already sends objects so integration works, but the contract diverges from the stated 'list of profile names'.

Recharts logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on dashboard (chart container sizing). Dialog logs a React hydration warning: <span> child of <option> in template-select, plus 'Missing Description/aria-describedby' on DialogContent. Non-blocking but noisy.
failed.evidence: Console warnings captured during dashboard + subscription-dialog interactions.

action_items: Optional: align backend profile_users schema with the 'list of profile names' spec OR update the spec/docs to reflect the ProfileUser object contract.
Optional: fix Recharts container sizing on dashboard and remove <span> inside <option> in SubscriptionDialog template-select; add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to dialogs.
